prerequisites: The account owner must be at least 18 years old and able to enter a binding agreement.
An automated agent must act with the account owner's authorization.
Automated creation of multiple accounts is prohibited.
Paid wallet access requires a funded wallet that can authorize USDC payment on Base.

plans.name: Free
plans.requiredFor: Free API access through standard account signup.

plans.name: Build
plans.requiredFor: 30-day paid access available through standard checkout or x402 USDC payment.

plans.name: Pro
plans.requiredFor: 30-day paid access available through standard checkout or x402 USDC payment.

plans.name: Scale
plans.requiredFor: Higher usage limits through standard checkout.

mechanisms.description: An authorized agent can purchase 30-day Build or Pro access for a new or existing eligible wallet. An unknown wallet receives an account and API key only after successful x402 settlement.
Free access uses standard account signup. Standard checkout also supports paid plans.

methods.notes: POST /v1/web3/subscribe without the payment header returns x402 payment terms. Sign the USDC authorization, build the x402 v2 payload, base64-encode it, and retry in the payment-signature header.

credentials.ttl: No fixed key expiry while the account remains active.
credentials.rotation: Create and revoke keys through the account dashboard or documented wallet key-management endpoints.

scopes.notes: Plan entitlements and limits are published on the pricing page and in the developer documentation.

gaps: Free account creation uses standard signup; the retired wallet-only Free signup endpoint does not create an account or API key.
